posts.title: The Recent Year of Listening
posts.description: Picking up from where I left off on last year's music blog. Spotify calculated that I listened to 101,903 minutes of music over the past year. I continued my trend from 2024 and before of pushing into more aggressive metal music while simultaneously spending a lot of time with alternative and pop-style artists that got me into music years ago.
